title: Koki
description: Koki is a Cameroon classic prepared with black-eyed peas, scotch bonnet pepper, yellow onion, banana leaf. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans or peas in plentiful cold water for 480 minutes, then drain and discard the soaking liquid; keep refrigerated in hot conditions.
Grind drained black-eyed peas into a smooth thick paste with palm oil, chili and onion; beat thoroughly to lighten.
Spoon the paste into clean banana leaves and wrap into sealed parcels; place on a rack in the steamer.
Place leaf-wrapped portions in a steamer over gently boiling water and steam for about 65 minutes until fully cooked; use clean food-safe leaves.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
